entries.a: We deliver all over Lebanon. Beirut is $3, outside Beirut is $5, and delivery is free on orders over $60. Orders usually arrive in 1-3 days.
You can pay by cash on delivery, OMT, Whish Money, or bank transfer. We do not take card payments online yet.
You can exchange any unworn item with tags within 7 days. We cover the exchange delivery once. Refunds are store credit.
Our tees and hoodies are true to size with a relaxed fit; the Oversized Beirut Tee runs one size large. Jeans and cargo use waist sizes (28-36). Tell me your usual size and I'll help you pick.
We are online-only. You can order 24/7 here and our team replies between 9am and 8pm Beirut time.
We are an online shop with no physical store. Everything is ordered and delivered through WhatsApp.
If something is out of stock, tell me the item and your number and I'll flag it so the team can let you know when it is back.
